entities.name: Q9YFM7 2-methylisocitrate lyase
observations: Exact sequence match to the 308-residue query; reviewed UniProt annotation identifies the protein as 2-methylisocitrate lyase.
Catalyzes cleavage of (2R,3S)-2-methylisocitrate to pyruvate and succinate via an alpha-carboxy-carbanion intermediate.
Requires Mg2+ and is annotated as EC 4.1.3.30; reported as a homotetramer.
Associated with the methylcitrate cycle and propionate degradation.

entities.name: 2-methylisocitrate cleavage
observations: (2R,3S)-2-methylisocitrate is cleaved to pyruvate and succinate; Rhea RHEA:16809.
The reaction is a thermodynamically favored C-C bond cleavage and does not represent a redox transformation.

entities.name: Magnesium ion
observations: Mg2+ is the annotated cofactor for 2-methylisocitrate lyase.

entities.name: Methylcitrate cycle
observations: The enzyme participates in short-chain fatty-acid catabolism, particularly propionate degradation through the methylcitrate cycle.
